body.title: tests: add comprehensive error handling tests
body.body: ## Summary <!-- Provide a clear and concise description of what this PR changes and why it's needed --> Closes #87 ## Changes - ✅ Added 47 new test cases covering various error scenarios - ✅ Tests for CREATE TABLE syntax errors (missing columns, invalid data types) - ✅ Tests for INSERT statement errors (missing values, malformed syntax, invalid formats) - ✅ Tests for SELECT edge cases (missing FROM, invalid projections, unsupported expressions) - ✅ Tests for UPDATE/DELETE incomplete statements - ✅ Tests for WHERE clause and ORDER BY errors - ✅ Tests for management statement errors (DESCRIBE, DROP TABLE) - ✅ Tests for general syntax errors (unclosed strings, mixed quotes, unbalanced parenthe…
